Subject: Outreach redlines (summary)

Liam / Outreach Legal — thanks for the proposal. I ran a redline and summarized our primary concerns in the attached doc (Outreach_Redlines_v2.docx). High-level items:

- Data ownership and export: require explicit, irrevocable data export rights and an SLA for bulk export within 7 business days.
- Termination for convenience: ask for 60-day termination for convenience on annual contracts (rather than full-year obligation).
- Limitation of liability: carve out data breach and indemnity for regulated data; we need clearer language.
- Subprocessors: require list and 30-day notice before adding new subprocessors.
- SOC 2: provide the latest SOC 2 Type II report and point-of-contact for audits.

We also flagged a pricing inconsistency in Exhibit A (seat tiers). Neha: please see the pricing callout — we need final approval on PO cadence and whether finance can sign via delegated authority.

If Outreach can accept the redlines above (or propose narrow alternatives), we can proceed to DocuSign next week.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
priom_das@redwood.ai

Attachment: Outreach_Redlines_v2.docx

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@outreach.io>

Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Outreach redlines (summary)

Thanks for the redlines, Priyom — appreciate the thoroughness. Quick responses to the bullets:

- Data export: we can commit to a 7-business-day bulk export SLA and will add the language to Section 9.
- Termination for convenience: standard policy is no pro-rata for annual term, but we can offer a 60-day notice with pro-rata refund for the unused period for enterprise customers — I'll confirm sign-off from contracts.
- Limitation of liability: Outreach cannot fully remove standard caps, but we can carve out incidents involving regulatory fines and confirm cyber liability insurance limits.
- Subprocessors: happy to provide current list and 30-day notice before material additions.
- SOC 2: attaching contact for the SOC 2 report; we will share the most recent report under NDA.

On pricing: we can offer a $10k enablement credit if Redwood signs before 2026-03-18 and extend a 12% discount (instead of 10%) for a 12-month renewal; for a 24-month commitment, we can move to 18% and lock pricing for two years. I'll get an updated proposal and a DocuSign link with these terms by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Liam
